3-0: RANDOM LIMIT. How many elements CREATE fills with random values, per set (A0, B0, C0). Empty = 20.
RANDOM LIMIT. Number of set A elements CREATE randomizes, counted from the first. Empty = 20.
RANDOM LIMIT. Number of set B elements CREATE randomizes, counted from the first. Empty = 20.
RANDOM LIMIT. Number of set C elements CREATE randomizes, counted from the first. Empty = 20.
RANDOM LEVEL. Chance that CREATE touches a property at all. Low = calm, few changes; high = wild.
RANDOM LEVEL. Chance (0-100 %) that a set A property gets new random values on CREATE. Empty = 30.
RANDOM LEVEL. Chance (0-100 %) that a set B property gets new random values on CREATE. Empty = 30.
RANDOM LEVEL. Chance (0-100 %) that a set C property gets new random values on CREATE. Empty = 30.
GATE A, CENTER. How many elements a touched property reaches. Pairs with gate A II.
GATE A, CENTER. Average chance (0-100 %) that a touched property changes each set A element. Empty = random.
GATE A, CENTER. Average chance (0-100 %) that a touched property changes each set B element. Empty = random.
GATE A, CENTER. Average chance (0-100 %) that a touched property changes each set C element. Empty = random.
GATE A, SPREAD. How much gate A varies between properties. 100 = every property alike.
GATE A, SPREAD. Higher = all set A properties reach about the same share of elements. 0 = anything goes.
GATE A, SPREAD. Higher = all set B properties reach about the same share of elements. 0 = anything goes.
GATE A, SPREAD. Higher = all set C properties reach about the same share of elements. 0 = anything goes.
GATE B, SPREAD. How similar the new values of one property are across elements.
GATE B, SPREAD. Higher = set A elements get close values for the same property. 0 = fully scattered.
GATE B, SPREAD. Higher = set B elements get close values for the same property. 0 = fully scattered.
GATE B, SPREAD. Higher = set C elements get close values for the same property. 0 = fully scattered.
GATE B, LINKS. How far link properties (references to other elements) may reach.
GATE B, LINKS. For set A link properties: 0 = may point to any earlier element, 100 = no links.
GATE B, LINKS. For set B link properties: 0 = may point to any earlier element, 100 = no links.
GATE B, LINKS. For set C link properties: 0 = may point to any earlier element, 100 = no links.
COLOR CHANCE. Chance each element takes a color from the palette (color III/IV).
COLOR CHANCE. Chance (0-100 %) that a set A element gets a palette color on CREATE. Empty = 100.
COLOR CHANCE. Chance (0-100 %) that a set B element gets a palette color on CREATE. Empty = 100.
COLOR CHANCE. Chance (0-100 %) that a set C element gets a palette color on CREATE. Empty = 100.
COLOR PROPERTIES. Chance each color property (fill, text, border ...) uses the palette.
COLOR PROPERTIES. Chance (0-100 %) that a set A color property is painted from the palette. Empty = 10.
COLOR PROPERTIES. Chance (0-100 %) that a set B color property is painted from the palette. Empty = 10.
COLOR PROPERTIES. Chance (0-100 %) that a set C color property is painted from the palette. Empty = 10.
PALETTE I. Colors CREATE may pick from: hex values without #, joined by dots.
PALETTE I. Colors for set A, e.g. ff8800.222222.f4f1ea (hex without #, dot separated).
PALETTE I. Colors for set B, e.g. ff8800.222222.f4f1ea (hex without #, dot separated).
PALETTE I. Colors for set C, e.g. ff8800.222222.f4f1ea (hex without #, dot separated).
PALETTE II. More colors for the same pool as palette I, same format.
PALETTE II. More colors for set A, e.g. 0055ff.ffffff (hex without #, dot separated).
PALETTE II. More colors for set B, e.g. 0055ff.ffffff (hex without #, dot separated).
PALETTE II. More colors for set C, e.g. 0055ff.ffffff (hex without #, dot separated).
COLOR MAP. Recolors the whole artwork: its tones are mapped onto these colors.
COLOR MAP. Color for the dark tones, hex without # (e.g. 1a1a2e). Fill one to three stops.
COLOR MAP. Color for the middle tones, hex without #. Works with any mix of the three stops.
COLOR MAP. Color for the light tones, hex without # (e.g. f4f1ea).
BACKGROUND IMAGE. How many elements show the background image (picked in the image tree).
BACKGROUND IMAGE. Last N elements of set A show the image. Empty = 100 (all), 0 = none.
BACKGROUND IMAGE. Last N elements of set B show the image. Empty or 0 = none.
BACKGROUND IMAGE. Last N elements of set C show the image. Empty or 0 = none.
BACKGROUND FIT. Size and anchor of the background image, as one preset number 0-89.
BACKGROUND FIT. set A: size x 9 + anchor. Size 0 cover, 1 contain, 2-9 zoom; anchor 0 top ... 4 center left ... 8 bottom right.
BACKGROUND FIT. set B: size x 9 + anchor. Size 0 cover, 1 contain, 2-9 zoom; anchor 0 top ... 4 center left ... 8 bottom right.
BACKGROUND FIT. set C: size x 9 + anchor. Size 0 cover, 1 contain, 2-9 zoom; anchor 0 top ... 4 center left ... 8 bottom right.
ROTATE / DIRECTION. 00 turns the three sets; A0-C0 set the direction they shift in.
ROTATE. Turns sets A, B, C by 0/90/180/270 degrees: value = 16 x A + 4 x B + C (each 0-3).
DIRECTION. Direction set A moves in: 0 = left, 25 = up, 50 = right, 75 = down. Distance is the row below.
DIRECTION. Direction set B moves in: 0 = left, 25 = up, 50 = right, 75 = down. Distance is the row below.
DIRECTION. Direction set C moves in: 0 = left, 25 = up, 50 = right, 75 = down. Distance is the row below.
STACK / DISTANCE. 00 sets which set lies on top; A0-C0 how far each set moves.
STACK ORDER. Which of A, B, C lies on top: 1-5 pick the other stacking orders, empty = default.
DISTANCE. How far set A moves in the direction above: 1 = 4 px sideways or 3 px up/down.
DISTANCE. How far set B moves in the direction above: 1 = 4 px sideways or 3 px up/down.
DISTANCE. How far set C moves in the direction above: 1 = 4 px sideways or 3 px up/down.
WIDTH / FRAME X. 00 is the artwork width; A0-C0 add a left/right frame to each set.
ARTWORK WIDTH. Width of the whole artwork in px. Empty = 600.
FRAME X. Left and right border of set A: 1 = 4 px.
FRAME X. Left and right padding of set B: 1 = 4 px.
FRAME X. Left and right padding of set C: 1 = 4 px.
HEIGHT / FRAME Y. 00 is the artwork height; A0-C0 add a top/bottom frame to each set.
ARTWORK HEIGHT. Height of the whole artwork in px. Empty = 300.
FRAME Y. Top and bottom border of set A: 1 = 3 px.
FRAME Y. Top and bottom padding of set B: 1 = 3 px.
FRAME Y. Top and bottom padding of set C: 1 = 3 px.
MORPH X. Thins or thickens shapes horizontally (SVG filter, applied before painting).
MORPH X. For the whole artwork: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH X. For set A: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH X. For set B: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH X. For set C: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH Y. Thins or thickens shapes vertically, same scale as morph x.
MORPH Y. For the whole artwork: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH Y. For set A: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH Y. For set B: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
MORPH Y. For set C: 1-49 thin by that many px, 50-99 thicken (99 = 1 px, 50 = 50 px).
WAVE X. Ripples shapes with noise; this sets the horizontal ripple frequency.
WAVE X. For the whole artwork: horizontal ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples). Pairs with wave y.
WAVE X. For set A: horizontal ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples). Pairs with wave y.
WAVE X. For set B: horizontal ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples). Pairs with wave y.
WAVE X. For set C: horizontal ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples). Pairs with wave y.
WAVE Y. Vertical ripple frequency, same scale as wave x.
WAVE Y. For the whole artwork: vertical ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples).
WAVE Y. For set A: vertical ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples).
WAVE Y. For set B: vertical ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples).
WAVE Y. For set C: vertical ripple frequency, 1-100 (higher = finer ripples).
WAVE Z. Strength and kind of the ripple set by wave x/y.
WAVE Z. For the whole artwork: 0-49 soft noise, stronger upward; 50-100 hard turbulence, stronger downward. Empty = 20.
WAVE Z. For set A: 0-49 soft noise, stronger upward; 50-100 hard turbulence, stronger downward. Empty = 20.
WAVE Z. For set B: 0-49 soft noise, stronger upward; 50-100 hard turbulence, stronger downward. Empty = 20.
WAVE Z. For set C: 0-49 soft noise, stronger upward; 50-100 hard turbulence, stronger downward. Empty = 20.
CANVAS V. Curve handles for style 3 (curved strokes).
CANVAS. CURVE 1 Y. Style 3: vertical pull of the first curve handle, 30 = cell edge.
CANVAS. CURVE 2 X. Style 3: second handle; with curve 2 x and y set the stroke bends twice.
CANVAS. CURVE 2 Y. Style 3: vertical pull of the second curve handle.
CANVAS. CURVE RANDOM X. Style 3: random extra horizontal pull for both handles.
CANVAS. CURVE RANDOM Y. Style 3: random extra vertical pull for both handles.
CANVAS IV. Arc start, rotation/direction and the first curve handle.
CANVAS. ARC START. Style 1: where the arc begins, 50 = 180 degrees.
CANVAS. ARC START RANDOM. Style 1: random extra start angle.
CANVAS. TURN. Style 1: rotation, 50 = 180 degrees. Styles 2/3: stroke direction, 0-100 = 8 directions.
CANVAS. TURN RANDOM. Random extra rotation (style 1) or direction (styles 2/3).
CANVAS. CURVE 1 X. Style 3: horizontal pull of the first curve handle, 30 = cell edge.
CANVAS III. Vertical jitter, stroke width and arc cut.
CANVAS. JITTER Y. Random vertical offset of each mark: 30 = up to half a cell.
CANVAS. LINE WIDTH. Stroke width, 1 = 0.5 px. Above 0 it also turns squares and dots into outlines.
CANVAS. LINE RANDOM. Adds up to value/2 px of random stroke width.
CANVAS. ARC CUT. Style 1: how much of each circle is left out, 50 = half, 100 = all.
CANVAS. ARC CUT RANDOM. Style 1: random extra cut on top of arc cut.
CANVAS II. Mark width, height and horizontal jitter.
CANVAS. WIDTH. Overrides mark size for the width only (same scale as mark size).
CANVAS. WIDTH RANDOM. Overrides size random for the width only.
CANVAS. HEIGHT. Overrides mark size for the height only (same scale as mark size).
CANVAS. HEIGHT RANDOM. Overrides size random for the height only.
CANVAS. JITTER X. Random horizontal offset of each mark: 30 = up to half a cell.
CANVAS I. Redraws the artwork as a grid of marks (squares, dots, strokes). Core setup.
STYLE. 0 squares, 1 dots/arcs, 2 straight strokes, 3 curved strokes. Any canvas value turns the effect on.
CANVAS. GRID X. Horizontal spacing of the drawn marks: 3 px + 2 px per step. Empty = 3 px.
CANVAS. GRID Y. Vertical spacing of the drawn marks: 3 px + 2 px per step. Empty = 3 px.
CANVAS. MARK SIZE. 0 = one grid cell, 30 = smallest, 60 = two cells, 90 = three.
CANVAS. SIZE RANDOM. Adds up to value/30 cells of random size to every mark.
PIXI FX. WebGL filter laid over the finished render. 0 or empty = off.
PIXI FX. 0 off, 1 ascii, 2 noise, 3 dots, 4 crt, 5 simplex, 6 glow, 7 blur, 8 bloom, 9 zoom blur, 10 twist, 11 bulge, 12 glitch, 13 reflection.
PIXI P1. 1 size, 2 amount, 3 scale, 4 line width, 5 strength, 6 distance (slow), 7 strength, 8 threshold, 9 strength, 10-11 height pos, 12 slices, 13 edge.
PIXI P2. 2 seed, 3 angle, 4 contrast, 5 scale, 6 inner glow, 7 pixel x, 8 bloom, 9 inner radius, 10-11 radius, 12 offset (50 none), 13 wave start.
PIXI P3. 4 curve, 5 offset, 6 outer glow, 7 pixel y, 8 quality, 9 ring width, 10 angle, 11 strength (50 none), 12 direction, 13 wave end.
PIXI P4. 4 vertical lines (>50), 5 step (>50, ~100 blanks), 6 alpha, 7 quality, 8 pixel size, 9 height, 12 sample size, 13 wavelength.
OPENCV FX. Photo effect on the finished render (preview and export). 0 or empty = off.
OPENCV FX. 0 off, 1 invert, 2 edges, 3 stylization (slow on large renders), 4 detail enhance.
OPENCV P1. Edges: lower threshold, higher = fewer edges. Stylization/detail: higher = less smoothing.
OPENCV P2. Edges: upper threshold, higher = fewer lines. Stylization/detail: higher = sharper edges.
OPENCV P3. Fade back to the original, every effect: 0 = full effect, 100 = untouched.
OPENCV P4. Edges only: line thickness, 1 px at 0 up to 9 px at 100.
LABELS. Style of the text labels (F0) placed on sets A, B and C.
LABEL MARGIN. Space around each label in px.
LABEL PADDING. Space inside each label: value + 2 px.
LABEL BORDER. Border width in px; 0 is a valid value (no border).
LABEL SIZE. Font size = 16 px + value (negative values shrink). Empty = unchanged.
LABEL BOTTOM. true = labels sit at the bottom of their element. Empty = false.
RESOLUTION. Frame and pixel size of the render; the multipliers scale the artwork size.
MARGIN X. Transparent space left and right of the artwork, in px (scaled with it).
MARGIN Y. Transparent space above and below the artwork, in px (scaled with it).
PADDING. Space captured around the artwork, in px. Empty = 10.
EXPORT SIZE. Multiplier 1-10, empty = 5. Cost grows with the square; capped at 32 MP and 16384 px a side.
PREVIEW SIZE. Multiplier 1-10. Empty = auto: sharp on any monitor, never below 4. Same cap as export.
LAYOUT. Look of the TUI itself: theme, table height and preview position.
THEME. TUI color theme 0-19 (also F10/F11). Applied on CREATE.
TABLE HEIGHT. 1-9 shrinks the table area (12 - value rows) for a bigger preview. Empty = 12 rows.
PREVIEW PAN. If the preview is wider than its pane: 0-100 % shifts which part is shown.
PAN AXIS. true = the pan above moves vertically instead of sideways. Empty = false.
3-1: CSS LAYOUT FLEX-GROW / SHRINK. Controls how the element claims or yields space within its flex container — 0 keeps it rigid.
CSS LAYOUT WIDTH. Base width of the element; the flex and min/max constraints below may override it.
CSS LAYOUT MAX- MIN-WIDTH. Clamps the width — the element never exceeds the max nor collapses below the min.
CSS LAYOUT HEIGHT. Base height of the element.
CSS LAYOUT MAX- MIN-HEIGHT. Clamps the height, analogous to the width bounds above.
CSS LAYOUT MIN-HEIGHT ASPECT-RATIO. Locks the element's proportions; works against the min-height constraint when the two compete.
CSS LAYOUT ALIGN-SELF. Cross-axis alignment of this element, overriding the container default. => start, ends, center, stretch
CSS LAYOUT MARGIN-LEFT -RIGHT. Horizontal alignment via auto margins — a selector, not a distance; use the plain CSS MARGIN below for numeric spacing. => start, ends, center
CSS LAYOUT ORDER. Visual position in the flex flow, independent of the row order in this sheet — lower values render first.
CSS LAYOUT LEFT POSITION. Horizontal offset of the element from its reference edge.
CSS LAYOUT TOP POSITION. Vertical offset of the element from its reference edge.
CSS LAYOUT LEFT WIDTH. Horizontal extent paired with LEFT POSITION — together they pin the element's placement along the x-axis.
CSS LAYOUT TOP HEIGHT. Vertical extent paired with TOP POSITION — the y-axis counterpart.
CSS MARGIN-LEFT -RIGHT. Numeric outer spacing on the horizontal sides — pushes neighbours away.
CSS MARGIN-TOP -BOTTOM. Numeric outer spacing on the vertical sides.
CSS PADDING-LEFT -RIGHT. Inner spacing on the horizontal sides — insets the content from the element's own edge.
CSS PADDING-TOP BOTTOM. Inner spacing on the horizontal sides — insets the content from the element's own edge.
HTML RELATION ENTITY. Assigns the element to its parent container in the layout tree — this reference decides which flex context all properties above operate in.
CSS LAYOUT WIDTH. Base width of the element; the min/max constraints below may override it.
CSS LAYOUT MAX- MIN-WIDTH. Clamps the width — the element never exceeds the max nor collapses below the min.
CSS LAYOUT HEIGHT. Base height of the element.
CSS LAYOUT MAX- MIN-HEIGHT. Clamps the height, analogous to the width bounds above.
CSS LAYOUT MIN-HEIGHT ASPECT-RATIO. Locks the element's proportions; works against the min-height constraint when the two compete.
CSS LAYOUT MARGIN-TOP -BOTTOM. Vertical alignment via auto margins — a selector, not a distance; use the plain CSS MARGIN below for numeric spacing. => start, ends, center
CSS LAYOUT MARGIN-LEFT -RIGHT. Horizontal alignment via auto margins — the x-axis counterpart of the selector above. => start, ends, center
CSS LAYOUT Z-INDEX. Stacking order relative to overlapping elements — higher values render on top.
CSS LAYOUT LEFT POSITION. Horizontal offset of the element from its reference edge.
CSS LAYOUT TOP POSITION. Vertical offset of the element from its reference edge.
CSS LAYOUT LEFT WIDTH. Horizontal extent paired with LEFT POSITION — together they pin the element's placement along the x-axis.
CSS LAYOUT TOP HEIGHT. Vertical extent paired with TOP POSITION — the y-axis counterpart.
CSS MARGIN-LEFT -RIGHT. Numeric outer spacing on the horizontal sides — pushes neighbours away.
CSS MARGIN-TOP -BOTTOM. Numeric outer spacing on the vertical sides.
CSS PADDING-LEFT -RIGHT. Inner spacing on the horizontal sides — insets the content from the element's own edge.
CSS PADDING-TOP -BOTTOM. Inner spacing on the vertical sides.
HTML RELATION ENTITY. Assigns the element to its parent container in the layout tree — reparenting moves the element and all its spacing into a new context.
3-2: CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. First shadow layer — horizontal offset.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. First shadow layer — vertical offset.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. First shadow layer — blur radius; higher values soften the edge.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. First shadow layer — spread radius; grows or shrinks the shadow body.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. First shadow layer — inset toggle; casts the shadow inward instead of outward.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Second shadow layer — horizontal offset; layers stack on top of the first.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Second shadow layer — vertical offset.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Second shadow layer — blur radius.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Second shadow layer — spread radius.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Second shadow layer — inset toggle.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE -POSITION. Horizontal sizing of the background image within the element.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE -POSITION. Vertical sizing of the background image.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE -POSITION. Horizontal placement of the background within the element.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE -POSITION. Vertical placement of the background.
CSS BACKGROUND-CLIP -ORIGIN. Defines which box the background paints into and is measured from. => border, content, padding
CSS BORDER-LEFT. Width of the left border edge; 0 disables it.
CSS BORDER-RIGHT. Width of the right border edge.
CSS BORDER-TOP. Width of the top border edge.
CSS BORDER-BOTTOM. Width of the bottom border edge — the four edges are independent.
CSS OUTLINE-WIDTH. Thickness of the outline drawn around the element; unlike borders it never affects layout.
CSS OUTLINE-OFFSET. Gap between element edge and outline — negative values pull it inside.
CSS OUTLINE-STYLE. Line style of the outline. => inset, outset, dotted, dashed
CSS BORDER-STYLE. Line style shared by all four border edges. => inset, outset, dotted, dashed
CSS BORDER-TOP-LEFT-RADIUS. Horizontal radius of the top-left corner.
CSS BORDER-TOP-LEFT-RADIUS. Vertical radius of the top-left corner — unequal values yield elliptical corners.
CSS BORDER-TOP-RIGHT-RADIUS. Horizontal radius of the top-right corner.
CSS BORDER-TOP-RIGHT-RADIUS. Vertical radius of the top-right corner.
CSS BORDER-BOTTOM-LEFT-RADIUS. Horizontal radius of the bottom-left corner.
CSS BORDER-BOTTOM-LEFT-RADIUS. Vertical radius of the bottom-left corner.
CSS BORDER-BOTTOM-RIGHT-RADIUS. Horizontal radius of the bottom-right corner.
CSS BORDER-BOTTOM-RIGHT-RADIUS. Vertical radius of the bottom-right corner.
CSS LAYOUT TRANSLATE. Horizontal shift of the element after layout — moves the rendering, not the layout slot.
CSS LAYOUT TRANSLATE. Vertical shift of the element after layout.
CSS LAYOUT SCALE. Horizontal scaling factor; 1 is natural size.
CSS LAYOUT SCALE. Vertical scaling factor — unequal x/y values distort deliberately.
CSS LAYOUT ROTATE. Rotation of the element around its transform origin.
CSS LAYOUT TRANSFORM-ORIGIN. Anchor point that rotate and scale pivot around. => top, left, right, bottom, angle nw, angle sw, angle ne, angle se
CSS LAYOUT JUSTIFY-CONTENT. Distribution of children along the main axis of this container. => start, ends, evenly, around, between
CSS LAYOUT ALIGN-CONTENT -ITEMS. Distribution and alignment of children along the cross axis. => ends, center, stretch, evenly, around, between
CSS LAYOUT FLEX-DIRECTION. Main axis of the container — row or column, optionally reversed.
CSS LAYOUT FLEX-WRAP. Whether children overflow onto new lines or stay on one.
CSS STYLE Z-INDEX. Stacking order relative to overlapping elements — higher values render on top.
CSS STYLE OVERFLOW. How content exceeding the element's bounds is handled, per axis or both. => both, axis x, axis y
CSS STYLE VISIBILITY DISPLAY. Toggles the element — hidden keeps its layout slot, none removes it entirely. => none, hidden, visible
CSS BACKGROUND-COLOR. Fill color of the element behind any background image.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Color of the first shadow layer defined above.
CSS STYLE BOX-SHADOW. Color of the second shadow layer.
CSS BORDER-COLOR. Color shared by all four border edges.
CSS OUTLINE-COLOR. Color of the outline.
CSS BACKGROUND-IMAGE. Selects the image painted inside the element.
CSS BACKGROUND-IMAGE. Repeat behavior of the background image.
CSS STYLE LINEAR-GRADIENT. Direction the linear gradient runs in. => top, left, right, bottom, angle nw, angle sw, angle ne, angle se
CSS STYLE RADIAL-GRADIENT. Shape of the radial gradient. => circle, ellipse, conical
CSS STYLE BORDER-IMAGE. Gradient type painted into the border. => linear, radial
CSS STYLE BORDER-IMAGE. Tuning value for the border gradient.
CSS STYLE LINEAR-GRADIENT -RADIAL. Tuning value shared by the gradient definitions above.
CSS STYLE BACKDROP-FILTER. Blur applied to whatever lies behind the element — frosted-glass effect.
CSS STYLE DROP-SHADOW. Horizontal offset of the filter-based shadow — unlike box-shadow it follows the rendered silhouette, including transparency.
CSS STYLE DROP-SHADOW. Vertical offset of the filter-based shadow.
CSS STYLE DROP-SHADOW. Blur radius of the filter-based shadow.
CSS STYLE BRIGHTNESS. Lightens or darkens the element as a whole.
CSS STYLE OPACITY. Overall transparency of the element and everything in it.
CSS STYLE SEPIA. Warms the element toward sepia tones.
CSS STYLE GRAYSCALE. Drains color toward monochrome.
CSS STYLE SATURATE. Intensifies or mutes the element's colors.
CSS STYLE CONTRAST. Widens or flattens the tonal range.
CSS STYLE HUE-ROTATE. Shifts every color around the hue wheel.

CSS MIX-BLEND-MODE. How the element's pixels combine with what lies beneath — 0 leaves normal compositing. => 1=hue, 2=color, 3=screen, 4=lighten, 5=darken, 6=overlay, 7=multiply, 8=saturation, 9=luminosity, 10=color dodge, 11=color burn, 12=hard light, 13=soft light
CSS STYLE ISOLATION. Creates a fresh stacking context — fences blend modes so they stop at this element instead of bleeding into the canvas below.
3-4: VARIOUS PROPERTIES. Image settings of the element — the image lives as a CSS background, so framing, cropping, and scaling are all driven from here.
CSS PADDING-LEFT. Left inset of the image frame; with the matching background-origin, padding crops into the image from this side.
CSS PADDING-RIGHT. Right inset of the image frame.
CSS PADDING-TOP. Top inset of the image frame.
CSS PADDING-BOTTOM. Bottom inset — the four sides are independent, allowing asymmetric framing.
CSS BACKGROUND-ORIGIN. Decides which box the image is measured against — and thus whether the paddings above frame it or crop it.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE. Base fitting mode of the image within the element. => contain, auto, 100%
CSS BACKGROUND-POSITION. Anchor preset for placing the image — coarse positioning before fine-tuning. => top, left, right, bottom, angle nw, angle sw, angle ne, angle se
CSS BACKGROUND-POSITION. Numeric horizontal offset — fine-tunes the placement relative to the anchor above.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE. Numeric horizontal scaling — overrides the fitting mode above for precise control.
CSS BACKGROUND-SIZE. Numeric vertical scaling; unequal values stretch the image deliberately.
CSS BACKGROUND-IMAGE. Selects which image this element renders — the file chosen via the image filetree.
3-5: VARIOUS PROPERTIES. Typography settings of the element's text field — every element from A00 to F99 carries one.
CSS PADDING-LEFT. Left inset of the text within its field.
CSS PADDING-RIGHT. Right inset of the text.
CSS PADDING-TOP. Top inset of the text.
CSS PADDING-BOTTOM. Bottom inset — the four sides are independent, so text can sit off-center deliberately.
CSS BACKGROUND-COLOR. Fill behind the text field — set for label-style plates, leave transparent to let the element's own styling show through.
CSS STYLE COLOR. Color of the text itself.
CSS ALIGN-SELF. Placement of the text field within the element along the cross axis. => start, end, center, stretch
CSS TEXT-ALIGN. Horizontal alignment of the text inside its field. => left, center, right, justify
CSS TEXT-DECORATION. Decorative lines applied to the text. => both, over, under
CSS FONT-WEIGHT. Weight of the type, from hairline to black — which cuts are available depends on the loaded font.
CSS FONT-SIZE LINE-HEIGHT. Type size and line spacing as a pair — the two values that set the text's vertical rhythm.
CSS FONT-FACE. Selects the typeface — one of the fonts loaded via the OTF filepicker.
HTML SPAN ENTITY. The text content itself — whatever this cell holds is what the element renders.
